description: A National Outdoor Climate Parameter Dataset for Climate-Resilient Building Energy Design in China is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Liu Yang, Haoning Wu (State Key Laboratory of Green Building). A National Outdoor Climate Parameter Dataset for Climate-Resilient Building Energy Design in China. This dataset includes: Typical Meteorological Year (TMY) Dataset Future Meteorological Year (FMY) Dataset Thermal Design Conditions Dataset HVAC Design Conditions Dataset Common station metadata Data Covers 1,000 meteorological stations across China. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
